# Pagination

Horizontal navigation between chunks (pages) of a dataset. Shows the first and last page plus the current page and a configurable number of sibling pages on each side, collapsing the rest into ellipses. Includes previous/next controls (disabled at the bounds), three sizes, optional text labels, and full RTL support. Modeled on Figma frames 7936:8133 (Pagination) and 7936:16660 (Pagination Item).

**Stylesheet:** `components/pagination/pagination.css`

**Behaviour:** `js/components/pagination.js` (classes `PaginationManager`); wired through `[data-static]`, `[data-page]`. Without it the markup renders but does not open, close or toggle.

Layout wrappers named `showcase-*` belong to the documentation page, not to the component: leave them out.

## Props / Configuration

Classes and the JS API for the pagination component.

| Class / API | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `.pagination` | Container | The <nav> wrapper. Add --sm / --lg to change size. |
| `.pagination-item` | Item | A page number or prev/next control. 40px square (md), borderless, rounded. |
| `.pagination-item.is-active` | State | The current page — filled with the primary token, white text. Pair with aria-current="page". |
| `.pagination-item.is-disabled` | State | Disabled prev/next at the first/last page. |
| `.pagination-item--nav` | Modifier | Marks a prev/next control (holds the arrow icon and optional label). |
| `.pagination-ellipsis` | Item | Non-interactive "…" gap marker. |
| `paginationRange(total, current, siblings)` | JS fn | Returns the token sequence (page numbers + "…") to render, per the DgaPagination algorithm. |
| `PaginationDemoManager` | JS class | Renders a dynamic, navigable pagination driven by total page count, current page, and sibling count. |

## Page Item States

Default, hover (gray fill), active (filled primary), and the non-interactive ellipsis. Prev/Next become disabled at the bounds.

```html
<nav class="pagination" aria-label="States">
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item">1</button>
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item is-active" aria-current="page">2</button>
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item">3</button>
    <span class="pagination-item pagination-ellipsis" aria-hidden="true">…</span>
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item">10</button>
</nav>
```

## Truncation

With many pages, the sequence keeps the first and last page and the current page ± the sibling count, collapsing the rest into ellipses — shown here near the start, middle, and end of a 20-page set.

```html
<nav class="pagination" aria-label="Start">
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item">1</button>
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item is-active" aria-current="page">2</button>
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item">3</button>
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item">4</button>
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item">5</button>
    <span class="pagination-item pagination-ellipsis" aria-hidden="true">…</span>
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item">20</button>
</nav>

<nav class="pagination" aria-label="Middle">
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item">1</button>
    <span class="pagination-item pagination-ellipsis" aria-hidden="true">…</span>
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item">9</button>
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item is-active" aria-current="page">10</button>
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item">11</button>
    <span class="pagination-item pagination-ellipsis" aria-hidden="true">…</span>
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item">20</button>
</nav>

<nav class="pagination" aria-label="End">
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item">1</button>
    <span class="pagination-item pagination-ellipsis" aria-hidden="true">…</span>
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item">16</button>
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item">17</button>
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item">18</button>
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item is-active" aria-current="page">19</button>
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item">20</button>
</nav>
```

## Boundary States

On the first page the Previous control is disabled; on the last page the Next control is disabled.

```html
<nav class="pagination" aria-label="First">
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item pagination-item--nav is-disabled" aria-label="Previous" disabled="">
        <svg class="pagination-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="m15 18-6-6 6-6"></path>
        </svg></button>
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item is-active" aria-current="page">1</button>

    <button type="button" class="pagination-item pagination-item--nav" aria-label="Next">

            <path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6"></path>
        </svg></button>
</nav>

<nav class="pagination" aria-label="Last">
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item pagination-item--nav" aria-label="Previous">
        <svg class="pagination-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">

        </svg></button>

        </svg></button>
</nav>
```

## Labels & RTL

Prev/Next can show text labels alongside the arrow. In RTL the whole control mirrors and the arrows flip.

```html
<nav class="pagination" aria-label="Labels">
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item pagination-item--nav" aria-label="Previous">
        <svg class="pagination-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="m15 18-6-6 6-6"></path>
        </svg><span>Previous</span></button>
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item">1</button>
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item is-active" aria-current="page">2</button>
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item">3</button>
    <button type="button" class="pagination-item pagination-item--nav" aria-label="Next"><span>Next</span>
        <svg class="pagination-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6"></path>
        </svg></button>
</nav>

<div class="showcase-preview--subtle" style="width: 100%; padding: var(--spacing-xl); border-radius: var(--radius-md);" dir="rtl">
    <nav class="pagination" dir="rtl" aria-label="RTL">
        <button type="button" class="pagination-item pagination-item--nav" aria-label="السابق">
            <svg class="pagination-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                <path d="m15 18-6-6 6-6"></path>
            </svg><span>السابق</span></button>
        <button type="button" class="pagination-item">١</button>
        <button type="button" class="pagination-item is-active" aria-current="page">٢</button>
        <button type="button" class="pagination-item">٣</button>
        <span class="pagination-item pagination-ellipsis" aria-hidden="true">…</span>
        <button type="button" class="pagination-item">١٠</button>
        <button type="button" class="pagination-item pagination-item--nav" aria-label="التالي"><span>التالي</span>
            <svg class="pagination-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                <path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6"></path>
            </svg></button>
    </nav>
```
